result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a wide multi-lane roadway with embedded streetcar tracks and a marked zebra crosswalk. While sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the long crossing distance and sightline obstructions from parked vehicles create significant safety challenges.

hazards.name: Streetcar Tracks
hazards.description: Embedded tracks in the roadway can cause tripping for pedestrians or catch bicycle tires.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes and tracks without a refuge island, increasing exposure time.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the crosswalk limit visibility between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image near the crosswalk

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near the intersection to clear sightlines.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Markings
interventions.description: Refresh and extend the zebra markings across the entire width of the road to improve driver awareness.

result.summary: The image shows a signalized intersection in a residential area with multi-story apartment buildings. While sidewalks are present on both sides, there is a complete lack of marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals, forcing pedestrians to cross an unmarked, wide roadway.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crosswalk
hazards.description: There are no painted markings to delineate pedestrian space at this signalized intersection.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: A portable generator or piece of equipment is blocking the sidewalk path.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicular lights.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or zebra-style crosswalk markings to increase driver awareness of pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear right-of-way information.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The image shows a residential street intersection with a marked zebra crosswalk and traffic signals. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the environment is challenged by embedded trolley tracks and parked vehicles that may obstruct sightlines at the crossing.

hazards.name: Embedded Trolley Tracks
hazards.description: Metal tracks in the roadway can be slippery when wet and present a tripping hazard for pedestrians or a trapping hazard for bicycle tires.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway, running parallel to traffic flow

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection and crosswalk can block the sightlines between approaching drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image along the curb line near the intersection

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic gets a green light.
